title: ViewSense for CodeIgniter settings
description: Settings for ViewSense in this CodeIgniter project. Every setting is optional.

$schema.description: Optional. The address of this JSON schema, for editors without the ViewSense extension. VS Code with ViewSense doesn't need it.

version.description: CodeIgniter version. Detected from the project files when not set.

appFolder.description: Folder with the application code, relative to the project root. Default: "application" (CodeIgniter 3) or "app" (CodeIgniter 4).

viewsFolder.description: Folder CodeIgniter loads views from, relative to the project root. Default: "views" or "Views" inside the application folder.

viewCalls.description: Project methods and functions that render a view, on top of the ones CodeIgniter provides.

method.description: Name of a method that renders a view, e.g. "render" for $this->render('products/list', $data).

function.description: Name of a function that renders a view, e.g. "include_view" for include_view('partials/card', $data).

view.description: Position of the view name argument, starting at 0.

data.description: Position of the data argument, starting at 0, or null when the call passes no data. Default: the argument after the view name.

layout.description: A layout view the method also renders with the same data, e.g. "layouts/main".
